// Use a regex pattern to match HTML entities like &, <, etc.
Pattern pattern = Pattern.compile("(&[a-zA-Z0-9]+;)");
// Use a map to store HTML entities and their corresponding characters
Map<String, String> htmlEntityMap = new HashMap<>();
htmlEntityMap.put("&", "&");
htmlEntityMap.put("<", "<");
htmlEntityMap.put(">", ">");
htmlEntityMap.put(""", "\"");
htmlEntityMap.put("'", "'");
htmlEntityMap.put(" ", " ");
// Create a matcher object to find matches in the input text
Matcher matcher = pattern.matcher(text);
// Use a StringBuilder to efficiently replace the HTML entities with their characters
StringBuilder unescapedText = new StringBuilder();
int lastEnd = 0;
while (matcher.find()) {
// Append the text from the last match to the current match
unescapedText.append(text, lastEnd, matcher.start());
// Replace the HTML entity with its character equivalent
unescapedText.append(htmlEntityMap.getOrDefault(matcher.group(), matcher.group()));
// Update the last end position to continue from where the current match ends
lastEnd = matcher.end();
// Append any remaining text after the last match
unescapedText.append(text.substring(lastEnd));
return unescapedText.toString();
